the service was alive on 2024-06-01: title 'Log in to your account', description 'cooldebrid is a Premium Download Manager. Get files at premium speeds from all filehosts. Stream Torrents with cooldebrid.'
an anonymous GET of the root on 2026-11-25 answered 200 with 45102 bytes and no challenge, so the previously recorded 404 is no longer the current state
the root now serves a live premium link generator page advertising 63 supported filehosts

record.notes: Found through an Italian-language query ('servizio debrid'), which is why the English lists never carried it. The 404 is the whole finding: no parked page, no redirect, no explanation.
